correctness.rationale: The quadratic form on F2^4 has six q=1 points, sixteen translates with pairwise block intersection two, and 808 nonempty simplices; all faces of cardinality >=3 lie in unique six-point blocks. Signed simplicial Lefschetz traces give tr_H2=f_g-C(f_g,2)+t_g-1+sum_fixedblocks(1-f_C+C(f_C,2)-t_C), using rational H0=Q and H2=Q^55; the previously published exact open-rook neighborhood complex gives the requisite homology. Independent enumeration of all 720 symplectic linear maps and sixteen translations reconstructed character histogram {-5:240,-1:4230,0:2304,1:4640,7:105,55:1} and averages 10 over translations, zero over full G. Rational geometric quotient invariants follow from barycentric subdivision plus transfer. No integral quotient claim.
